create_string_game_data: create training and evaluation DataLoaders from StringGame-v0 replay buffer data for seq2reward model training
train_seq2reward_model: train a Seq2RewardNetwork model using PyTorch Lightning on provided training data with configurable learning rate and epochs
eval_seq2reward_model: evaluate a trained seq2reward model on evaluation data and return initial state Q values, MSE loss, and action distribution
train_seq2reward_compress_model: train a compress model using FullyConnected network to approximate a trained seq2reward model on provided data
gen_permutations: generate all action permutations for a given sequence length and number of actions as a tensor
